title: Unconscious information can drive higher cognition

statements.text: Unconscious information can influence task preparation, motivation, goal pursuit, learning, arithmetic, response inhibition and error detection. This suggests awareness has no special immediate utility for behavior, which fits the higher-order view better than views that tie awareness to performance.

sources.quote: recent studies have shown that unconscious information can facilitate or at least influence higher cognitive functions such as task preparation
These findings suggest that awareness might not have 'special' utility
